content.text: Now targeting: both ad groups restricted to Ireland + UK, plus keywords on one and follower lookalikes on the other.
All approved. Verify targeting, then activate.

content.thinking: Campaign's live for Ireland and the UK, promoting all 3 posts to drive clicks to /demo, with the $350 split across two ad groups ($15/day pharmacy-keyword targeting, $10/day lookalike-audience targeting), both ending 19 August Dublin time. I'll monitor daily performance and shift budget toward whichever group performs better.

content.text: Day 1 (6 Aug): $20.34 spent, 23,553 impressions, 8 link clicks, all from Ireland/UK targeting. It's too early to change anything, so I'll check again tomorrow.

content.thinking: Day 2 totals: $44.59 spent across 20 clicks (~$2.23/click), with the pharmacy-keyword and follower-lookalike ad groups performing similarly, and the "school-run queue" post leading while the price post lags. Pace is on track at ~$312/14 days, under the $350 cap, so I'll hold off on changes until the numbers grow.

Day 4 numbers: $87.62 spent, 102,340 impressions, 39 clicks (~$2.25/click), still Ireland/UK only — the "school-run queue" post drives 27 clicks vs. 3 for the price post, with X already shifting delivery toward the stronger ad, so I'm keeping both ad groups since they're performing similarly. I missed checking on the 8th but nothing broke, and I'll resume daily checks going forward.

Day 5 check shows keyword and lookalike ad groups at similar CPCs (~$2.36 vs $2.40), but neither is hitting its daily cap, leaving ~$45 unspent at this pace. I'll expand the keyword list with more pharmacy-trade terms to boost delivery, keeping the $350 budget cap unchanged.
